population.span: A total of 269 children (aged 6 months to 14 years) with otitis media and/or respiratory tract infections were enrolled in a double-blind, randomized placebo-controlled trial

endpoint.span: antibiotic-associated diarrhoea (diarrhoea caused by Clostridium difficile or otherwise unexplained diarrhoea)

estimate.span: [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]

ci.span: [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]

analysis_set.span: Analyses were based on allocated treatment and included data from 246 children.

treatment_strategy.span: they received standard antibiotic treatment plus 250 mg of S. boulardii (experimental group, n = 132) or a placebo (control group, n = 137) orally twice daily for the duration of antibiotic treatment.

follow_up.span: occurring during or up to 2 weeks after the antibiotic therapy

served_mismatch: The corrected AAD numbers in served_row.source match the abstract. However, the served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly established: the source reports analysis by allocated treatment using data from 246 of 269 enrolled children. The source does not support analysis of all randomized children.

candidate_rejections.span: [nine of 119 (8%) vs. 29 of 127 (23%), relative risk: 0.3, 95% confidence interval: 0.2-0.7]
candidate_rejections.why: This is the broader diarrhoea endpoint, not the separately reported antibiotic-associated diarrhoea endpoint. Reject the legacy candidate described in served_row.source.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population comprises children receiving antibiotics, within the question's population; the intention-to-treat analysis requirement is not fully established.
entry_population_matches_question.span: they received standard antibiotic treatment plus 250 mg of S. boulardii (experimental group, n = 132) or a placebo (control group, n = 137) orally twice daily for the duration of antibiotic treatment.

notes: All spans are from the held abstract. The follow-up window is stated in the broader diarrhoea definition and is not separately repeated for AAD. The held text does not establish the 'Can 2006' author/year attribution in served_row.source.
